title: Hyderabad big-tech pay band: is ₹3–6 crore/year realistic?
topic: Hyderabad technology job market at Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta tier
audience: Someone deciding whether Hyderabad has that compensation band
governingThought: ₹3–6 crore total compensation in Hyderabad exists only at the extreme tail of verified big-tech levels — median Google/Microsoft/Amazon software packages cluster around ₹25 lakh–₹1.3 crore, not ₹3 crore+.
takeaways: **₹3 crore (~₹30M) is rare:** [Google Hyderabad L6 median](https://www.levels.fyi/companies/google/salaries/software-engineer/locations/greater-hyderabad-area) ≈ **₹19.9M**; [Amazon L6 max reported](https://www.levels.fyi/companies/amazon/salaries/software-engineer/locations/greater-hyderabad-area) ≈ **₹12.2M** — both below ₹30M.

**₹6 crore (~₹60M) is not supported** by public Levels.fyi medians for Hyderabad SWE — [Microsoft L67 median](https://www.levels.fyi/companies/microsoft/salaries/software-engineer/locations/greater-hyderabad-area) ≈ **₹25.2M** (highest listed Microsoft level in dataset).

**Typical senior band:** Most L5/E4–L6/E5 equivalents land **₹60 lakh–₹1.3 crore** TC in Hyderabad ([Levels.fyi city aggregate](https://www.levels.fyi/t/software-engineer/locations/greater-hyderabad-area) median **₹31.1 lakh** across all employers).

Who might approach ₹3 Cr — and who will not
How to use this data when negotiating

blocks.text: Indian tech compensation is usually quoted as **CTC / total compensation (TC)** per year, mixing base salary, RSU/stock vesting (annualized), and bonus. **₹3 crore = ₹30,000,000/year** (~₹25 lakh/month gross components combined). **₹6 crore = ₹60,000,000/year**.

Social posts claiming “₹3 Cr offers in Hyderabad” often conflate **one-time grant value**, **USD offers**, or **outlier self-reports** with steady-state TC. This brief uses [Levels.fyi](https://www.levels.fyi/) self-reported medians (last updated **May–Aug 2026** on cited pages).

blocks.title: Meta in Hyderabad specifically
blocks.text: Levels.fyi publishes **India-national** Meta SWE medians, not a Hyderabad-only page. [Meta India E5 median ≈ ₹10.06M](https://www.levels.fyi/companies/meta/salaries/software-engineer/locations/india). A third-party guide citing Hyderabad Meta averages of ~₹41.4 LPA ([UpGrad blog](https://www.upgrad.com/blog/meta-software-engineer-salary-in-india/)) is [unverified] against Levels.fyi city splits.

sections.title: Who might approach ₹3 Cr — and who will not

blocks.text: **Verdict: ₹3–6 Cr/year TC is not a mainstream Hyderabad big-tech band** for standard software engineering tracks in public compensation datasets as of this brief.

items: **Below ₹3 Cr but solid:** Google L6 (~₹2 Cr), Microsoft 66–67 (~₹1.9–2.5 Cr), Amazon L6 (~₹1.2 Cr) — these are **senior/staff-adjacent** roles requiring many years of experience.

**₹3 Cr threshold:** No median on cited Levels.fyi Hyderabad pages reaches ₹30M. Approaching it would require unreported **Principal/Distinguished (L7+ / 68+ / E6+)** offers, exceptional refresh grants, or USD-denominated packages — none verified here.
**₹6 Cr:** No public Levels.fyi median for Hyderabad SWE approaches ₹60M. Treat viral claims as [unverified] unless backed by redacted offer letters in curated datasets.

**Hyderabad vs Bengaluru:** City premium exists but is modest ([JobsByCulture aggregate table](https://jobsbyculture.com/blog/software-engineer-salary-india-2026) lists Hyderabad mid-level ~₹16–28L vs Bangalore ~₹18–30L) — not a 3× multiplier.
Anchor expectations to **level mapping** (Google L5 vs Amazon L5 vs Microsoft 63 — not the same seniority).
Compare **TC components** separately: base, stock/RSU vest schedule, sign-on, bonus.

Cross-check multiple sources: [Levels.fyi](https://www.levels.fyi/), peer offers on [Blind](https://www.teamblind.com/) [unverified], and company filings for executive pay only (not individual IC offers).
If targeting ₹3 Cr+, plan for **staff/principal scope**, international transfer, or leadership comp — not default Hyderabad mid-senior SWE.
